```python
U = 1 << 128

def atlas(routes):
    """routes: dict (start,length)->hop  =>  (starts:list[int], hops:list[int|None])"""
    if not routes:
        return [0], [None]
    adds = {}; rems = {}
    for (start, length), hop in routes.items():
        adds.setdefault(start, []).append((length, hop))
        end = start + (1 << (128 - length))
        if end < U:
            rems.setdefault(end, []).append((length, hop))
    positions = sorted(set(adds) | set(rems) | {0})
    live = {}   # length -> hop
    heap = []
    runs_s = []; runs_h = []
    for pos in positions:
        for length, hop in rems.get(pos, ()):
            live.pop(length, None)
        for length, hop in adds.get(pos, ()):
            live[length] = hop
            heapq.heappush(heap, -length)
        while heap and -heap[0] not in live:
            heapq.heappop(heap)
        val = live[-heap[0]] if heap else None
        if not runs_h or runs_h[-1] != val:
            runs_s.append(pos); runs_h.append(val)
    return runs_s, runs_h
```
